name: Runway Garter Lingerie Set
swap_rule: Se cita el id. Se cambian material, grosor, transparencia, estampado y color. El corte no se reescribe.

transparencia_range.interpretation: Fabric opacity: 1.0 = fully opaque, no transparency; 0.0 = fully transparent. Lower values make the fabric more see-through. Preserve the garment cut, seams, edges and decorative details.

pieces.panties: lace panties with garter straps and chain at the hip
pieces.gloves: long lace gloves extending up the arm
pieces.cape: long open fabric drape, held at the sides
